architecture.training_target: Meaning of delivered customer speech conditioned on legitimately available context, not the desired ledger, actor script, judge pass, bank policy permissions or tool action.
architecture.primary_intent: Descriptive conversational act relevant to the current question. Preserve other acts as clauses; the source-derived policy decides operative precedence. A learned primary rank cannot suppress a competing transfer, hardship, privacy or correction blocker.
architecture.hard_boundary: The learned function is pure, cannot mutate state, issue tools, set verified/recorded/permission, choose outcome codes or synthesize policy amounts/dates. Its absence or failure never relaxes an existing gate.
architecture.semantic_risk_limit: This boundary is necessary but not a proof of safety: a false target, polarity or paid classification can still cause a wrong note or offer. High-confidence proposals require independent evidence/normalization and end-to-end measurement; numerical confidence is never authority.

output_contract.partial_acceptance: Only independently evidenced, nonconflicting facts can be staged. Any unresolved authorization-relevant sibling or collective target blocks joint readback/write. Malformed envelope is atomic rejection, not silently salvaged consent.

state_and_dependency_graph.ordering: Construct a provenance DAG with newer dependent nodes pointing to immutable earlier evidence nodes. Negation/qualification within a turn uses span nodes and fresh hypothesis nodes. Do not overwrite history or create causal cycles. Working state is a compact projection, not full graph serialized every turn.
state_and_dependency_graph.learned_edges: Only semantic edge candidates. Receipt_for, readback_of and confirms authorization edges are created by the deterministic kernel from actual events.
state_and_dependency_graph.component_state: P[target,component] = {value_or_null, status, revision, evidence_refs, correction_epoch, source_kind}; status in unset,fragment,ambiguous,validated,superseded,recorded. Store amounts in source-defined smallest units or exact decimal strings, never binary-float equality for consent.
state_and_dependency_graph.correction_update: Let U_t be unresolved components in the active correction episode. A scoped new correction adds C_new and invalidates those old component revisions. Let E_new be components explicitly completed in this turn, scoped to that episode, asserted or safely resolved to an actually spoken offer, and deterministically validated. Set U_next=(U_t union C_new) minus E_new. Repeated fragments in the same episode do not reset previous independent completions. A genuinely later correction to a completed component starts its new revision and adds it back. A reference to superseded terms cannot clear U.
state_and_dependency_graph.unknown_scope: Do not manufacture amount+date labels from missing scalar fields. Record unknown_scope separately, block commitment, and ask which target/component changed. Newly explicit facts may be staged, but uncertainty is discharged only with sufficient scoped clarification under the declared reducer, not by blindly filling a two-slot checklist.
state_and_dependency_graph.sibling_retention: Resolve structure and scope first, then completion, then normalize only complete components. An unfinished date cannot discard a valid new amount. Unrelated target updates cannot complete or erase this target's episode.
state_and_dependency_graph.offer_identity: Offer IDs are kernel-generated per actual spoken terms and target revisions. Acceptance references the latest still-active offer(s) actually spoken, not a freshly recomputed default/deadline. Once accepted, preserve those terms through administrative questions and product interleaving unless a real scoped correction, source-policy invalidity or explicit rejection occurs. No calendar recomputation from wall clock.
state_and_dependency_graph.collective_semantics: Store shared-date/total scope explicitly. Splitting a collective utterance into per-target clauses must preserve its collective_id and policy-defined collective-date behavior. A total is not copied as each product's amount. All explicit targets must resolve before mutation.
state_and_dependency_graph.readback_gate: Generate a fresh readback only when target set and all required components are resolved and policy-valid. Snapshot exact immutable revisions and policy hash, then record actual speech. Any new terms, correction, unresolved qualifier, stale/missing event or policy change invalidates confirmation; retained facts need not be lost.
state_and_dependency_graph.confirmation_gate: A later turn than the completed readback must clearly affirm that exact snapshot, with no contradictory/new/incomplete terms, unresolved target, qualifier or pending transfer/stop condition. A learned affirmative cannot grant consent. Require existing qualified fixed-extractor/faithful whole-reply evidence path and kernel checks; absent reliable evidence, clarify and re-read. Independent admin aside may preserve facts and reference context but never weaken the evidence requirement.
state_and_dependency_graph.operation_gate: Verified backend identity, returned product provenance, exact source policy/API validity, required disclosures, matching active readback and confirmation, unrecorded target, no overriding source-priority branch, and bounded operation state must all hold. Notes, callbacks, transfers, verification and close have their own source-derived gates; no universal payment-confirmation shortcut.
state_and_dependency_graph.receipts: Only operation-bound bank body ok:true establishes success. Transport success alone does not. Consume completion signals with explicit neutral assignments for merge-persistent vars; old receipts cannot replay. Recorded promises remain immutable even during later model error.
state_and_dependency_graph.noninterference: Model may update only semantic_candidate namespace. It cannot alter policy, actual-bank-state, counters, readback/offer IDs, consent or route directly. The reducer returns explicit patch + diagnostics; no helper global side effects.
state_and_dependency_graph.deferred_decision_revision: Delayed refusal/persuasion state must bind target and component/offer revision. An explicit new valid proposal supersedes the corresponding delayed refusal; a later turn cannot replay its old offer and replace newly accepted terms.

trainable_models_and_losses.cpu_now: Multihead regularized linear models over bounded character 3-5 grams, word 1-2 grams and explicit safe context features. Target and offer references use candidate ranking with the same weights across dynamic candidates, not class-specific p1/p2 identities. Span candidate classifier/token BIO head can be added; unsupported span/target heads abstain initially.
trainable_models_and_losses.features: Fit vocabulary/IDF only on train. Prefer sorted explicit sparse vocabulary for reproducible stdlib inference. Delexicalize numeric/name/ID tokens for intent heads with protected offset map; keep raw spans for normalization. Negation/word order and role/phase/question/correction/offer-reference features must survive. Never erase a negation or join words across component boundaries.
trainable_models_and_losses.span_strategy: Token offsets from deterministic tokenizer; learned BIO or candidate-span scores for amount/date/target/security/negation/qualifier roles. Whole-expression completeness is a separate supervised head. Overlapping incompatible value spans abstain. Numeric regex candidates are proposals, not labels or proof of scope.
trainable_models_and_losses.loss: L = sum_i q_i sum_h m_ih lambda_h L_h / sum_i q_i sum_h m_ih + lambda_reg ||W||_2^2. m masks unknown/unannotated heads. Use softmax cross-entropy for exclusive intent/completion/polarity; binary cross-entropy for secondary acts; token cross-entropy/optional CRF for spans; pairwise or softmax ranking for dynamic target/offer references. Never encode unlabelled secondary acts as negative by default.
trainable_models_and_losses.initial_lambda: Start lambda_h=1 with per-head normalization; candidate grid for regularization and context ablations selected by grouped development loss. Report every head's coverage separately. Annotation reliability weights q are governance choices, not estimated ground-truth probabilities.
trainable_models_and_losses.safety_emphasis: Use class-weight/cost-sensitive training only as a development choice and recalibrate afterward. Missed corrections, negations, wrong target and false affirmation are measured independently; reward shaping cannot replace deterministic gates. Do not optimize judge pass as a per-turn label.
trainable_models_and_losses.distillation: Optional independently reviewed teacher distributions enter training only, with tracked teacher/version/prompt and weight. L_distill = T^2 KL(p_teacher || p_student); no calibration/holdout teacher labels presented as gold. Teacher proposals and examples generated from them stay in the same lineage group.
trainable_models_and_losses.next_model: Frozen local sentence encoder plus small heads is an offline comparator, not a runtime dependency. It may improve data efficiency, but sentence-only representations can erase scoped clauses; compare exact semantics and coverage. Export to code only through separately evaluated sparse distillation.
trainable_models_and_losses.h200_future: Explicit H200 requests and other providers remain outside this authorization. A Modal gpu=H100 request may receive an automatic H200 substitution at unchanged H100 GPU cost; that documented substitution is within the bounded H100 plan. Stronger labels and a demonstrated CPU representation limitation remain prerequisites.
trainable_models_and_losses.small_data_honesty: If some heads/classes have too few independent gold groups, leave them unqualified and abstaining. A model with only primary-intent training must not claim completion, target or consent competence.

calibration_and_ood.calibration: Choose model/hyperparameters on development, fit per-head temperature or scalar sigmoid calibration on calibration-fit only, then choose frozen selective thresholds on calibration-risk only. Use a separate untouched confirmation test. Do not fit per-class isotonic curves to tiny slices.
calibration_and_ood.probability_runtime: Stable softmax/sigmoid can use built-in exponentiation with bounded logits and subtraction of max; json/re/datetime only. Alternatively export monotonic margin-to-probability lookup evaluated against offline calibrator with an explicit approximation tolerance. No assumption math/numpy/torch/sklearn imports exist in sandbox.
calibration_and_ood.selection: A candidate must pass freshness/schema/span/target/qualifier checks, a calibrated class-specific threshold, a class margin condition and OOD veto. Untrained, uncalibrated or statistically unsupported head abstains by default. Joint risk is measured directly, not inferred by multiplying marginal confidences.
calibration_and_ood.ood: Measure unseen-feature mass, sparse nearest-training similarity, score margin, unknown language/alias/policy schema and out-of-range input lengths. Threshold on held-out OOD development families only. These are detectors with measured errors, not guaranteed OOD recognition. Unknown policy value alone is not OOD if correctly supplied through the generic contract.
calibration_and_ood.risk: R(tau)=errors among accepted / accepted; Coverage(tau)=accepted / all eligible. Abstention counts as a miss for end-to-end task recall, never as a semantic success. Report per-head and joint accepted-frame precision/recall, false-safe rate and correction/negation blocker recall.
calibration_and_ood.statistical_limit: Use independent lineage groups as units. With zero unsafe groups among n independent accepted groups, one-sided 95% upper error bound is 1-0.05^(1/n). About 299 groups are needed for <=1%; 598 for <=0.5%. Correlated turns and three repetitions of one scenario do not increase n. These illustrative bounds are not observed results.
calibration_and_ood.multiple_selection: Do not claim that a bound from the same data used to search thresholds is a confirmation guarantee. Predeclare a finite grid and correct simultaneous risk tests, or reserve independent confirmation groups. Conformal-style guarantees require stated exchangeability/monotonic-loss assumptions and do not cover arbitrary final-brief shift.

runtime_bundle.qualification: Per-head trained/calibrated/qualified booleans and measured dataset scope. Default false. Bundle is immutable and hash-pinned by builder.
runtime_bundle.budget_status: Provisional local acceptance targets, not documented Freya limits or measured performance. Fail closed at limits without silently truncating negation/corrections. Run smaller-vocabulary ablation if exceeded.
runtime_bundle.sandbox: Embed immutable data at builder-generation time; no filesystem/network/package import at call time. Only json/re/datetime verified and allowed by current guide. Do not serialize full weights/history into every vars patch. Compile and execute actual snippet in separated globals/locals harness; explicit return/vars updates only. Catch failures and reset proposal to abstain with current binding.
runtime_bundle.serialization: Avoid literal double-curly template markers even from adjacent dict braces in generated code. Prefer flat construction and safe literal escaping. Builder validates marker absence, output envelope, fallback route and every producer/consumer example.
runtime_bundle.latency_gate: Measure extraction+code+route+speech latency and no-progress turns, not just dot products. Folding inference into existing dispatch avoids a new graph hop. Runtime load/cold parsing and repeated payload cost are measured separately.

chosen_comparator.role: offline compact multilingual encoder/teacher comparator, never Freya runtime service
chosen_comparator.licence: MIT indicated by publisher model card; implementer pins and verifies exact revision/licence/tokenizer hash before download/training. No mutable main revision in reproducible run.
chosen_comparator.reason: Small encoder can test whether shared representations improve independently labelled paraphrases/multilingual scope compared with sparse lexical features. Its existing embedding benchmarks do not establish our semantics.
chosen_comparator.architecture: Start frozen encoder plus context-conditioned task heads; if development demonstrates gain, fine-tune only last two encoder blocks plus span/intent/polarity/reference heads. Use token states for scope; do not rely only on pooled sentence embedding. No generative teacher, giant LLM or large hyperparameter sweep.
chosen_comparator.input: Role-tagged current turn + minimal permitted previous question/offer context; token offsets map back to original turn. Sequence cap256 for pilot; overflow abstains/is separately evaluated, never truncates an authority-relevant suffix.
chosen_comparator.optimization: AdamW, fixed predeclared seed, BF16 only if device-supported, batch16 with gradient accumulation2; maximum3 epochs or1000 optimizer steps, whichever first, and wall timeout dominates. Freeze train/dev manifest before launch. Evaluate development only for early stopping; restore best dev checkpoint. Starting learning rates heads1e-3, encoder2e-5 are experiment choices, not proven optimal.
chosen_comparator.memory: One H100; target peak VRAM<=24GiB for this bounded small model, host memory16GiB and max2 physical CPU cores. Measure smoke; on OOM exit rather than retrying with more GPU/resources. No fit/memory claim before measurement.
